reasons.group-default-command: rejected: novelty verdict drop_in (click-default-group (click-contrib): DefaultGroup subclass of click.Group with default=NAME and default_if_no_args=True; runs the default subcommand when none is given, and other subcommands still work. The candidate puts the same behaviour into core as Group(default_command=...) and adds details such as completion and no_args_is_help handling, but the capability and shape are essentially the same.)

reasons.color-option-and-env: rejected: novelty verdict drop_in (click-extra colorize: a tri-state eager --color[=auto|always|never] option (plus --no-color) that sets ctx.color, and handling of NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, CLICOLOR and others. The differences are that click-extra's FORCE_COLOR treats falsy values as off, it covers more variables, and it works at the option layer rather than inside click._compat.should_strip_ansi.)
